deferredBoardJournal.digestAlgorithm: sha256 of ordinal filename|lowercase-file-sha256 lines joined with LF and no terminal LF

excludedOwnerRecords.reason: missing stable Fitness card identity or belongs to another product

card.title: Session Copilot / Progression Bot Interface
card.description: Complete the deterministic session-copilot action and recap contract while keeping the progression engine authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions remain deterministic and inspectable.
Recap truth persists into history.
The interface does not become an opaque chat-first coach.

card.title: Expand Achievements and Earned Notifications
card.description: Plan a richer deterministic achievements phase and once-only earned notifications after the current achievement review is accepted.
acceptanceCriteria: Milestone unlock rules remain deterministic and safe.
Notifications are deduplicated and consent-aware.
No public achievement feed or social-pressure loop is introduced.

card.title: Rebuild useful history metrics and progression analytics
card.description: Keep History focused on understandable, action-guiding training outcomes rather than filler statistics.
acceptanceCriteria: History surfaces useful progression outcomes.
Secondary diagnostics remain deeper in the flow.
Low-data states remain clear and truthful.

card.title: Offline-Ready PWA + Persistent Session Restore
card.description: Provide a resilient installed-app experience with bounded offline behavior and deterministic session restoration.
acceptanceCriteria: Installed sessions restore deterministically.
Offline edits fail closed or synchronize predictably.
Conflict and recovery states are explicit.

card.title: Harden Atlas Contracts and CI Environment Verification
card.description: Keep Fitness contract exports and environment verification deterministic across local and hosted CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Environment classification is deterministic.
Contract export and check commands produce stable results.
Hosted checks remain linked to their exact source identity.

card.title: Add Optional Planned Workout Days
card.description: Distinguish optional workout days from required and rest days without weakening adherence, missed-day, or streak truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Routine setup distinguishes required, optional, and rest days.
Skipped optional days do not count as missed required sessions.
Completed optional workouts contribute normal session and progression truth.

card.title: Show Live Active User Presence on Today
card.description: Show a privacy-preserving aggregate active-user count on Today without exposing individual identities.
acceptanceCriteria: Presence counting rules are deterministic.
Only aggregate presence is exposed.
Unavailable and stale states never present false precision.

card.title: Add per-day exercise templates for easy copy, paste, and modification
card.description: Provide reusable day-level exercise templates without expanding into broad routine sharing.
acceptanceCriteria: Day templates are reusable and editable.
The workflow is clear on mobile.
Routine sharing remains outside this card.

card.title: Make Workout Start Atomic
card.description: Make starting a workout an all-or-nothing step so an interrupted start never leaves a partial session behind.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a workout either fully succeeds or leaves no partial session.
Retried or double-tapped starts do not create duplicate sessions.
The change goes live only after the matching database update is reviewed and applied.

card.title: Enable Account Portal to Fitness Handoff
card.description: Let people who begin in the Fawxzzy account portal continue straight into Fitness without a second sign-in step.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening Fitness from the account portal lands the signed-in user in the app.
When the handoff is unavailable the user sees a clear sign-in path instead of a dead end.
The handoff stays off until readiness checks pass.

card.title: Complete Self-Service Account Tools
card.description: Finish the self-service account lifecycle: recovering a forgotten sign-in, changing your sign-in details, downloading your own data, and removing your account. Progress: changing sign-in details is merged and live, and saving a reset sign-in was fixed and is live, but neither has been exercised live yet. Recovery is not verified end to end. Data download and account removal are still planned. Not checked on a real phone.
acceptanceCriteria: Forgotten-sign-in recovery is verified end to end (not yet verified).
Changing sign-in details and saving a reset sign-in are exercised live (not yet done).
People can export their own data.
People can request account removal with a clear confirmation step.

card.title: Make Sign-In Outcomes Clear
card.description: Show a clear message whenever a sign-in attempt does not complete, instead of quietly returning to the sign-in form.
acceptanceCriteria: Every sign-in attempt that does not complete explains the next step.
Temporary delays tell the user how to retry.
Successful sign-in behavior is unchanged.

card.title: Respect the Local Day Boundary in Workout Streaks
card.description: Count streak days in the user's local time zone so an evening workout is credited to the day it was logged.
acceptanceCriteria: A workout logged in the evening counts toward that local calendar day.
Streak, best-streak, and calendar views agree on day boundaries.
Users without a saved time zone keep a clear, documented default.

card.title: Return a Proper Not-Found Status for Missing Pages
card.description: Pages for items that do not exist or are unavailable should respond with a real not-found status along with the friendly not-found screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing or unavailable pages respond with a not-found status, not a success status.
The friendly not-found screen still renders.
Existing pages are unaffected.

card.title: Finish Account Site Setup for the Fitness App
card.description: Complete the shared account site that Fitness relies on for sign-in, sign-out, forgotten-sign-in recovery and returning people to the app, so the account side is finished before more Fitness work builds on it. Done and live as of 2026-11-13: starting sign-up from the account site, clearer sign-up feedback messages, one global sign-out that also signs people out of the app, and saving a changed username or contact address. Checked live only in headless Chromium with a standing test account (sign-in, account site handoff, sign-out then redirect to sign-in); not checked on a real phone. Still open: the recovery link needs an owner setup step on the account side and a live check, and a real-phone pass is pending.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign-up, sign-in, sign-out and forgotten-sign-in recovery all work from the account site and return people to the Fitness app.
The account site and the app always agree on who is signed in.
Every account screen Fitness links to is complete and checked in the installed phone app (real-phone pass not yet done).

card.title: Send Branded Account Messages for Fitness and Mazer
card.description: Account messages such as forgotten-sign-in recovery now come from one no-reply Fawxzzy sender with a per-app look (Fitness green, Mazer cyan). Checked live on 2026-11-10 with a throwaway account: the message arrived, its link opened the new sign-in form, a new sign-in was saved and sign-in worked. Sign-up confirmation messages do not exist while sign-up confirmation is off, so none are sent or need checking; the remaining work is the reset and recovery message path. Not verified: change-of-address messages and other mail clients. The hourly send allowance was raised from 2 to 30 on 2026-11-11 (confirmed by reload); the delivery service's free tier allows 100 messages a day.
acceptanceCriteria: Account messages arrive from one branded sender with the app's own look (Fitness green, Mazer cyan).
Forgotten-sign-in recovery works end to end: the message arrives, its link opens the new sign-in form, a new sign-in is saved and works (checked live 2026-11-10).

The reset and recovery message path is finished: change-of-address messages are checked and other mail clients are reviewed (not yet verified). Sign-up confirmation messages are not needed while confirmation is off.
Daily and hourly send allowances are watched as use grows.

card.title: Lock Down Database Access for Signed-Out Visitors
card.description: On 2026-11-10 signed-out visitors lost the ability to run 5 Fitness database functions and 5 internal tables became deny-by-default. The change was applied by approved hash and a rollback file is kept. Re-tested live afterward: sign-in, portal handoff, History and workout resume. Not verified: finishing a workout and reordering a routine were not clicked through.
acceptanceCriteria: Signed-out visitors cannot run the five affected Fitness functions.
The five internal tables deny access by default and a rollback file is kept.
Sign-in, portal handoff, History and workout resume still work after the change (checked live 2026-11-10).
Finishing a workout and reordering a routine are clicked through after the change (not yet done).

card.title: Consistent cards across the app
card.description: Give every screen the same card look and behavior so the app feels like one product. Done: the shared card system is merged and live on the Routines, Today, Settings, Session and History screens. Checked only in headless Chromium, on development fixtures and in a signed-in render sweep of those screens (no overflow, no console errors, no controls under 32px), not on a real phone. Still to do: the routine editor and routine creation, heatmap labels under 11px, the History filter toggle and the logger plus and minus steppers at 44px, and retiring the old exercise card once nothing uses it.
acceptanceCriteria: Routines, Today, Settings, Session and History screens use the shared cards (merged and live).
Those screens pass a signed-in render sweep with no page overflow and no console errors (headless Chromium only).
Heatmap labels are at least 11px, and the History filter toggle and logger steppers are 44px (not yet done).
The routine editor and routine creation use the shared cards (not yet done).
The old exercise card and row are retired once no screen uses them (not yet done).
The result is checked in the installed phone app (not yet done).

card.title: Move to a supported framework version
card.description: The web framework the app is built on (Next 14) is past end of support. The latest patch release (14.2.35) is live, but remaining fixes only ship in newer major versions, so a framework upgrade to Next 15.5 or 16 together with React 19 is planned.
acceptanceCriteria: The app runs on a supported framework version.
The framework upgrade is tested before release and rolled out without breaking sign-in or workouts.
Everyday flows are checked live after the upgrade.

card.title: Cover the app with real interaction tests
card.description: Add a library for testing what people see and tap, sort out 13 stale tests that are currently left out of the all-tests job, and wire the QA scripts so they run together.
acceptanceCriteria: A screen-level test library is added and used for key flows.
The 13 stale tests are fixed or retired and included in the all-tests job.
QA scripts run together from one command.

card.title: Keep set logging working offline
card.description: Logging a set with the connection off now retries and syncs once the connection returns (quick-log retry and sync, #219 and #226), and each set keeps the time it was tapped rather than the time it was replayed (#234). Live. A click-through passed in headless Chromium. Not yet verified: a replay after reconnecting on a real phone.
acceptanceCriteria: Sets logged with the connection off are kept and retried.
After reconnecting, each set appears once.
Rest timing uses the real tap time, not the replay time.
A real offline-then-reconnect replay is checked on a real phone (not yet done).

card.title: Show when an exercise has no target
card.description: Today rows no longer show 'Goal missing' for an exercise without a target. Add a quiet 'No target set' cue so the gap stays visible without nagging. The day editor still shows the missing target.
acceptanceCriteria: An exercise without a target shows a quiet 'No target set' cue on Today.
Today rows do not show 'Goal missing'.
The day editor keeps showing the missing target.

card.title: Finish the remaining screens on the shared card style
card.description: Move the last screens onto the shared card style once the main screens are settled: the routine editor and routine creation, the exercise picker, the progression editor and the stretch panel. Also raise the remaining 9 to 10px text and the controls under 32px on those screens.
acceptanceCriteria: The routine editor, routine creation, exercise picker, progression editor and stretch panel use the shared cards.
No text on these screens is below the app minimum size, and no control is under 32px.
The screens are checked in a signed-in render sweep and on a real phone.

card.title: Smoother loading screen shared with Mazer
card.description: The app now opens on one shared loading screen that waits 150 ms before showing, stays up for at least 350 ms and fades in and out, with the same timing as Mazer. Live. Checked only in headless Chromium with phone emulation, including a slow network (solid cover at the first frame, hidden by about 840 ms, taps work). Not checked on a real phone: iOS home-screen launch and Reduce Motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Fast loads open without a flash of the loading screen.
The loading screen never sticks and taps work once it is gone.
Timing matches Mazer (150 ms delay, 350 ms hold, fades).
iOS home-screen launch and Reduce Motion are checked on a real phone (not yet done).

card.title: Small leftovers after the card redesign
card.description: Small items found after the card redesign: the Today offline info control has the wrong id, the History page has no top-level heading, and Finish shows minutes as 75 min instead of 1h 15m. Also still to do: 44px logger steppers and heatmap labels of at least 11px.
acceptanceCriteria: The Today offline info control has a correct, unique id.
The History page has one top-level heading.
Finish shows long durations as 1h 15m rather than 75 min.
Logger steppers are 44px and heatmap labels are at least 11px.
